rationale: The papers 2508.04264 and 2603.07715 investigate aspects of magnetized neutron stars and their magnetic field generation, contributing evidence relevant to the roles of buoyancy and superfluid turbulence in neutron star fields. However, they do not fully resolve the question posed.
